prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1318; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents front-quarter damage on the driver side, consistent with the impact described for a collision during a left-hand turn. The bumper cover is cracked and displaced, the headlamp assembly is broken, and the fender shows a crease running toward the wheel well. Inspection of the radiator support and hood latch found no further structural deformation. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the fender, refinishing the affected panels, and recalibrating the driver-assist sensor behind the grille. The labor hours listed are in line with the extent of the damage observed. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to me, and the invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same operations.
